waves.title: Harness validation, disk sweep, bring-up + ts rebalance sweeps
waves.instructions: Read and execute docs/build-stream/instructions-wave1.md in the worktree. The durable plan with acceptance criteria is docs/build-stream/2026-08-30-quant-bench-trackA.md (Phases 1-3). Hard rules: small tests before big tests (pilot + validate_v2 before any full run); save ALL logs and append docs/ledger/paper-notes BEFORE any container teardown or file deletion; official Qwen/Unsloth sampling settings per DEC-2 in the lifecycle file; bracket + re-test every marginal VRAM rung. Remote host: ssh multivac (2x RTX 5060 Ti). Artifacts on multivac under /srv/bench/e12/, pull copies back to data/raw/e12/ in the worktree.

waves.title: Official-settings validation pilots + MTP/DFlash setting sweeps
waves.instructions: Read and execute docs/build-stream/instructions-wave2.md in the worktree (lifecycle Phases 4-5). Same hard rules as wave1. Pilots first: reasoning_effort equivalence (G17), MTP losslessness at temp>0 (G8), presence-penalty behavior probe. Then MTP sweep (depth, draft-KV -ctkd/-ctvd, p-min) and DFlash2 sweep (n-max 4/7/8) per quant at short + full depth, 3-run medians.

waves.title: Accuracy instruments, agentic runs, context axis
waves.instructions: Read and execute docs/build-stream/instructions-wave3.md in the worktree (lifecycle Phases 6-8). Official sampling settings for all task benchmarks. Order: PPL-P1 UD-Q6_K -> code-NLL ladder (E2 rule) -> HumanEval+ gap-fill -> LCB v6 n=100 (5-problem pilot first) -> SWE-bench 25-smoke THEN 50 -> agentic steps -> Code-NIAH. CIs on everything (Wilson rates, bootstrap B=10000 seed 20260825 continuous).

waves.title: Speed/energy at chosen config, Track A decision, docs graduation
waves.instructions: Read and execute docs/build-stream/instructions-wave4.md in the worktree (lifecycle Phases 9-10). Speed curve at filled depths + J/tok; Track A decision procedure -> one config line per quant + fallback ladder; Track B data assembly with provenance fields; graduate findings into CLAUDE.md and PAPER-REFERENCES.md on multivac; ensure every headline number has a PAPER-NOTES entry.
